reviews.title: Muy buenas diademas para gaming y otras experiencias multimedia.
reviews.comment:
Esperaba que no fueran los que se mostraban ya que el precio era muy diferente a la versión negra.
Son de cable Jack 3.1, buena espuma, capta bien el sonido, tiene la membresía para tener audio 7.1 y viene bastante completo realmente.
Muy buen producto 10/10.
Lo único malo que he encontrado por ahora es que a veces por discord el sonido de videos se filtra.
reviews.author: Hamed Jesus Elneser Tejeda

reviews.title: Better than kraken
reviews.comment: Better than kraken.  A little tight on my head
reviews.author: Polo

reviews.title: Different Product
reviews.comment: The product was different than what was visually advertised, and though this is probably not due to the headphones, the audio from my system is picked up on my microphone
reviews.author: Hugo Hernandez

reviews.title: The mic sometimes doesn't work
reviews.comment: While i use the headset, as i have been using it for a while, the mic suddenly stops working and i either have to move the headset jack or reset my xbox. Other than that its a good headset.
reviews.author: Levi Baker

reviews.title: Snug
reviews.comment: Sound is great, mic is great. I really like the mute button on the left side. The reason for 3 stars, the headset is so snug that it may be comfortable for kids and small adult heads.
reviews.author: Trips
